_comment: Promise 8 (surfaces_agree) ratchet - Issue #1128 I6. Divergences between what a Climate Advisor surface shows and the band the engine arms, KNOWN on HEAD. A listed row is tolerated; an unlisted divergence fails tests/test_promise_surfaces.py; a listed row that no longer diverges also fails (remove it). Goldens are LOCKED, so known divergences are recorded here, never by editing a scenario. 'scenario' = one golden; 'context: generated' = the fixed generated sample in tests (seeds 101 and 102, 10 days each, profile coordinator). Regenerate evidence with: python tools/simulate.py --surfaces --generate 10 --seeds 101 102. 'issue' is a GitHub number ('unfiled' is allowed only for a harness-premise row). 'signature' lists the divergence shapes tolerated, as '<band>/<edge>' (band sleep|awake; edge low|high|low+high|reader_failed|text): a new shape on an already-ledgered surface FAILS, and a listed shape that stops occurring is stale.

divergences.evidence: HARNESS PREMISE, not a production claim: the scenario scripts 'whole-house fan already running' only through reconcile_fan_on_startup(thermostat_fan_running=True); the FakeHass fan.whole_house entity stays off, so the Fan (WHF) card says 'active' (adopted) against a physically-off fan. Revisit when the harness mirrors the scripted fan state into the entity.

Known and documented (#1089, closed): at night the chart draws the adaptive compute_bedtime_setback() sleep temperature while the engine arms the raw configured sleep_heat/sleep_cool, so they differ when a sleep temperature is outside the setback limits. E.g. day_seed 101000000 05:00: comfort_cool=sleep_cool=80 F, chart ceiling 78 F, thermostat armed at 80 F. Replay: python tools/simulate.py --generate-day 101000000
